transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?
Ever since I was there during that shooting, the scene keeps replaying in my head all day and I can’t shut it off. It's like a constant loop and I just can't get any peace.
How long has it been since the shooting happened? Have these replaying memories and distress been going on for more than a month, or less than a month?
The shooting happened just about a week ago, so it's definitely been less than a month. These memories and the distress started right after that night and have been going on every day since.

Since the shooting, have you felt emotionally numb, detached from yourself or your surroundings, or like things around you aren’t real? Have you had trouble remembering important parts of what happened?

I don't really feel detached or numb, but I definitely have some blank spaces in my memory about that night. I remember ducking behind my van and hearing people scream, but I can't picture how many shots there were or exactly where the shooter was. It's just a blank space that won't fill in no matter how hard I try to replay it.
Since the shooting, how much have these symptoms been affecting your daily life, like your sleep, work, or ability to be around other people? Have you been avoiding reminders of what happened?

It’s completely messed up my life—I barely sleep because I toss and turn and wake up at every noise, and I've even stopped going to my basketball games and choir. I'm actively avoiding my Westside routes, apartment complexes, and even talking about the shooting because it makes my chest tighten, which has my boss warning me that my job is on the line. I just can't bring myself to go near anything that reminds me of that night.

Before this shooting a week ago, had you ever had similar trauma-related symptoms from an earlier event, or did all of these symptoms start only after this shooting? Also, have they stayed continuous every day since then?

No, I've never gone through anything like this before, and all of these feelings started only after that night. It has been continuous every single day for the past week, and I just haven't been able to get any relief from it.
